title: Binance Says Hackers Took $6.3 Billion

beats.say: Binance says hackers took six point three billion dollars in twenty minutes.
beats.visual: a giant glass vault door slightly open in a dark server hall, thin cold light spilling out, no people

beats.say: The biggest crypto theft on record.
beats.visual: a tall stack of gold coins towering beside a much smaller stack on a black marble table, dramatic side light
a row of locked steel safety deposit boxes in a dim bank vault, one red indicator light glowing

beats.say: Binance says it will cover all losses from company funds.
beats.visual: a calm executive desk at night with a closed leather folder and a single lamp, city skyline through the window

beats.say: Reports say about three billion dollars was frozen.
beats.visual: a stack of gold coins encased in clear blue ice on a dark steel table, cold backlight

beats.say: Investigators point to a North Korea linked group. Binance has not blamed anyone yet.
beats.visual: a detective corkboard of blurred documents and red string under a desk lamp, no faces, shallow depth of field

beats.say: Binance first pointed to an engineer's laptop, then called it a more complex attack.
beats.visual: a lone laptop glowing on an empty office desk at night, screen showing only abstract light, rain on the window

beats.say: What can a saver learn? Not what to buy or sell. Just where your money sits.
beats.visual: a hand placing a single key on a wooden table beside a small brass lockbox, warm lamp light

beats.say: On an exchange, the company holds the keys. That promise is worth what the company can pay.
beats.visual: a ring of brass keys hanging on a hook inside a locked glass cabinet, moody light

beats.say: Hold your own keys, and the risk moves to you. Lose them, and nobody can reset them.
beats.visual: a small lockbox half buried in sand with a single key beside it, sunset light

beats.say: Proof of reserves is a public check that assets match what customers are owed.
beats.visual: a brass balance scale with gold coins on one side and paper receipts on the other, clean studio light

beats.say: Spread where your money sits, so one bad night in one place cannot freeze all of it.
beats.visual: a security guard desk with rows of dark monitors and one steady green light, empty chair

beats.say: Educational content, not financial advice. Free reset checklist, link in bio.
beats.visual: several small identical jars of coins placed in separate spots across a bright wooden shelf, daylight

beats.say: Educational content, not financial advice. Free reset checklist, link in bio.
beats.visual: a single warmly lit window in a small wooden house on a quiet night

caption:
Binance says hackers took $6.3 billion in about 20 minutes. What is confirmed, what is not, and where your money sits. Educational content, not financial advice.

Free reset checklist: link in bio.

description: Binance says about $6.3 billion was stolen in the largest crypto hack on record. Here is what has been confirmed, what investigators only suspect, and what it teaches about where your money sits.
first_comment: Where does most of your money sit: one place or several? Educational only, not financial advice.

facts.claim: Binance says about $6.3B stolen in ~20 minutes, largest crypto theft on record
Withdrawals paused, deposits open, resume expected in 45-48 hours
Binance will cover losses, set aside ~$6.34B
North Korea-linked attribution by TRM Labs/Chainalysis; Binance has not attributed
Engineer laptop first suggested, later 'more complex attack'
